{{Top}}
[[File:LukeMoistureVaporator-MOSW.png|thumb|right|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], standing by a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]].]]
'''Moisture farmers''' were harvesters of [[Water/Legends|water]] on very arid planets such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]]. The harvested water could be sold at a market or used by the farmers themselves in hydroponic gardens. The water was harvested using [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]], which were able to yield up to two liters of condensed water a day. However, this figure could vary dramatically depending on location. Areas of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], particularly near the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], were known to be particularly dry. On Tatooine, moisture farmers were often vulnerable to thieves and bandits who would steal their profits.

[[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], like his father [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]], was a moisture farmer on Tatooine. [[Ramiz]] was a moisture farmer on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].

[[Tahiri Veila]] was born to a couple of moisture farmers on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], that were descended from a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Old Order]].

The [[Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective/Legends|Tatooine Moisture Farm Collective]] often employed hunters to kill wild creatures that were known to attack moisture farmers.
